title: UserInputService.InputBegan
summary: Client event firing for every input START: keys, mouse buttons, touches, gamepad buttons. Receives an InputObject (KeyCode + UserInputType) and a gameProcessed flag — always check the flag.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Has .KeyCode (which key/button, Enum.KeyCode) and .UserInputType (what kind: Keyboard, MouseButton1, Touch, Gamepad1…).

parameters.name: gameProcessed
parameters.description: true = the engine/core UI already consumed it (typing in chat, default controls). Skip your logic when true.

explanation.whatItIs: The raw firehose of player input on the client.
explanation.whyItExists: Custom gameplay starts with detecting presses; InputBegan covers all devices in one event.
whenToUse: Touch/click detection when ContextActionService doesn't fit
Input state machines (tracking held keys with InputBegan/InputEnded)
whenNotToUse: Cross-device ACTION bindings with touch buttons — ContextActionService
Server-side — input is client-only; forward intents via remotes
tips: First line of every handler: `if gameProcessed then return end`
Check UserInputType when a KeyCode could be ambiguous (keyboard 'Space' vs gamepad button)
InputChanged for continuous values (mouse delta, triggers)
commonMistakes: Ignoring gameProcessed → abilities fire while typing in chat
Binding only Enum.KeyCode and forgetting mobile players have no keys
Heavy work per input event — input floods during drags/typing

examples.title: Robust keybind
examples.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        print("Flashlight toggled")
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        print("Screen tapped at", input.Position)
    end
end)
